package usecase

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

func TestPassedEvidenceUsesRequiredTargetsAndAllPassedRequiredStepIDs(t *testing.T) {
	shared := domain.Target{Type: "concept", Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"}
	optionalOnly := domain.Target{Type: "capability", Key: "go.optional", Version: "v1"}
	steps := []domain.Step{
		{ID: "step-1", Required: true, Status: "PASSED", Targets: []domain.Target{shared}},
		{ID: "step-2", Required: true, Status: "PASSED", Targets: []domain.Target{shared}},
		{ID: "step-3", Required: false, Status: "AVAILABLE", Targets: []domain.Target{optionalOnly}},
	}
	got, err := passedTargetEvidence(steps, true)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(got) != 1 || got[0].Target != shared || got[0].Correctness != 1 || got[0].Confidence != 1 || got[0].Independence != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected target evidence projection: %+v", got)
	}
	if len(got[0].StepIDs) != 2 || got[0].StepIDs[0] != "step-1" || got[0].StepIDs[1] != "step-2" {
		t.Fatalf("repeated required target did not retain ordered step attribution: %+v", got[0].StepIDs)
	}
}

func TestPassedEvidenceFailsClosedWhenRequiredTargetHasNoPassedStep(t *testing.T) {
	steps := []domain.Step{{ID: "step-1", Required: true, Status: "AVAILABLE", Targets: []domain.Target{{Type: "concept", Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"}}}}
	if _, err := passedTargetEvidence(steps, false); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("evidence was built without a passed required step")
	}
}

func TestCheckpointedStepAdvancesCurrentStepAndProgress(t *testing.T) {
	instance := domain.TaskInstance{Steps: []domain.Step{
		{ID: "step-a", Required: true, Status: "CHECKPOINTED"},
		{ID: "step-b", Required: true, Status: "AVAILABLE"},
	}}
	setCurrentStep(&instance)
	if instance.CurrentStep == nil || instance.CurrentStep.ID != "step-b" || instance.Progress.PassedSteps != 1 || instance.Progress.TotalSteps != 2 || instance.Progress.Percentage != 50 {
		t.Fatalf("checkpointed milestone did not advance progress: current=%+v progress=%+v", instance.CurrentStep, instance.Progress)
	}
}
